_comment: M2.3 activity definitions and interaction points for Sector 01 / Left Wing / Floor 1. Source of truth for Content/CyberWarden/Schedule/DA_S01_LW_F1_Activities (generated by Tools/ConfigureActivities.py, validated by Tools/ValidateActivities.py). An interaction point is keyed by the destination marker id used in the schedule JSON, so it applies to every NPC that goes there. Every animation is optional; missing ones degrade to the normal idle pose.

activities._note: PLACEHOLDER pose: the existing Manny idle (MM_Idle). The activity is the purposeful alignment (facing the TV) until a real watching/leaning animation is acquired for Stage B/C.
